title: A Missing Bit String of Prescribed Length
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $Q$ be a finite list of binary strings with $|Q|<2^n$. Then there is a binary string $z$ of length $n$ that does not occur in $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: $Q$ is a finite list of binary strings
